purpose: Shared game/audio generation input, deterministic plan, version join, semantic event adapter and failure isolation integration checks.
caveat: Game generation is simulated by a small independent task. Runtime calls are mocked; no PCM is rendered and no subjective quality is inferred.
checks: same normalized shared input gives identical plan
extra shared world metadata affects brief hash
profile event aliases never leak into explicit bindings
game becomes ready while audio generation waits
independent game/audio tasks join by exact shared version
contract version and binding changes invalidate join
failed audio generation does not block game generation
adapter constructs no context and never autoplays
unknown and unmapped events never fall back to beeps
payload finite ranges and stale event versions checked
semantic event maps to the exact canonical cue
per-event frequency and concurrent rate reservations enforced
shared cue events keep independent rate limits
failed sound attempts do not consume event cooldown
audio failure and broken error observer cannot break a game callback
browser unlock failure remains explicit and locked
unsupported plan version is safely disabled
runtime source paths exist on disk
no fictitious audio files or asset digests
